title: On maximum hands-off restricted hybrid control for discrete-time switched linear systems
summary: This paper deals with design of maximum hands-off hybrid control sequences for discrete-time switched linear systems. It is a sparsest combination of a discrete control sequence (i.e. the switching sequence) and a continuous control sequence, both satisfying pre-specified restrictions on the admissible actions, that steers a given initial state of the switched system to the origin of the state-space in a pre-specified duration of time.
